svg.title: I-ITSM | User management, authentication and configuration

g.text: I-ITSM | User management, authentication and configuration
+create(role: Role, name: String, email: String, password: String) : User
UserFactory creates concrete subtypes and hashes passwords with PasswordEncoder.
Registration creates Employee accounts; administrative user management selects roles.
ViewMapper creates DTOs; generated Lombok getters are deliberately omitted from all sheets.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
